name: mercadopago
description: The MercadoPago API allows developers to exchange information with the Mercado's platform. Mercado Pago is an online payment company that processes payments for businesses globally.

name: clearbit-company-autocomplete
description: The Clearbit Company Autocomplete API allows developers to integrate the API service into their applications, allowing them to take a partial company name and returns full company names, domains, and logos, and more. The API is REST based, and returns data in JSON format. Clearbit is a provider of Business Intelligence APIs.

name: clearbit-enrichment
description: The Clearbit Enrichment API integrates person lookup features that include name, location, and social handles. It is available in REST architecture with JSON format and SSL standard.

name: coupa-core
description: Coupa offers Business Spend Management software, with solutions for transactions across procurement, payments, and supply chain. The Coupa Core RESTful API enables users to retrieve and manage data from the platform including accounts, budget lines, business entities, currencies, departments, projects, payment terms, suppiers, shipping, users, taxes, transaction resources (approvals, charges, payments, expense reports, etc.), and shared resources (form, commodities, comments, budget period, tagging, etc.).

name: clearbit-logo
description: The Clearbit Logo REST API allows developers to access and integrate the functionality of Clearbit with other applications. The main API method is retrieving a company's logo. Clearbit offers solutions for developers to construct business intelligence APIs.

name: clearbit-webhooks
description: Clearbit Webhooks allows developers to access other Clearbit APIs, such as Reveal, through webhooks that connects the service for the time of response. Developers can link up endpoints of Clearbit APIs to webhooks through webhook IDs in account settings. Clearbit offers solutions for developers to construct business intelligence APIs.

name: jive-data-company-lookup
description: The Jive Data Company Lookup API lets you find important information about companies - including Ticker(s), Full Company Name, Addresses, Phone Number, Fiscal Year, CIK, SIC Code, EIN, and company CUSIPS

name: natural-insight-routing
description: The Natural Insight Routing API

name: bunchball
description: The Bunchball API allows developers to access Bunchball's Nitro platform, which offers enterprise gamification for improving employee engagement. The platform includes a flexible rules engine that enables developers to build programs tailored to their specific audiences and use cases. Bunchball Nitro also comes with advanced analytics and prebuilt UI modules.

name: target365
description: Target365 enables several business to consumer tools including communications (SMS, email, and business chat), digital payments, and CRM support. Target365 offers fixed payment fees, 99.99% uptime, and chat bots. Target365 offers SDKs in several languages for easy integration.

name: gem-consulting-retail-pricing-optimizer
description: This API uses AI to compute the best possible prices for products given the product cost and minimal markup.

name: hubspot-company-properties
description: The HubSpot Company Properties API allows developers to create, update, delete, or get properties for companies. It can also be used to create, update, delete, and get groups of company properties. HubSpot provides a stack of products that include customer relationship management, marketing, and sales services.

name: roll
description: The ROLL API provides a GraphQL platform for mutable queries associated with business projects, sales pipelines, and analytics. The API requires Tokens for authentication. ROLL is business management platform designed to improve business performance by implementing an all-in-one full visibility service that covers financial situation, sales, time reporting, and project tracking summaries.

name: owler
description: The Owler REST API allows developers to access and integrate the functionality of Owler with other applications. Some example API methods include retrieving company information, retrieving competitor information, and retrieving feeds. Owler is a business intelligence platform that allows users and companies to find information about other companies and competitors.

name: besttime
description: BestTime API enables users to add data about the best times to visit a business into applications.

name: clearbit-prospector
description: The Clearbit Prospector API integrates contacts and emails fetching features, associated with a company, employment role, seniority, and job title. Access the REST interface with Key to send & receive JSON responses using an SSL standard.

name: natural-insight-routing-0
description: The Natural Insight Routing API in SOAP architecture exports routing data in XML format, allowing to collect and calculate expenses. The Routing API provides insight into how a client can change routing policies to prevent the financial drain from routing expenses. Each XMLelement within the tag will be presented in chronological order according to the date each Route within the date range chosen has occurred.

name: hermes-easeitcz
description: The Hermes API is an access portal to business profiles more than 3.5 million companies registered in the Czech Republic. It limits free access to company search by name, and require $10 monthly subscription for full database access. The API sends requests and returns responses in JSON format.

name: tradefeeds-company-information
description: Tradefeeds Company Information API allows developers to obtain data on essential company information. Company profile overview that includes mission, vision and values, executive leadership, contact information, sector and industry in which the business organizations operates are compiled into comprehensive data retrievable from our API database.

name: printapi-print-url-to-pdf
description: You can convert any public or private Webpage to PDF file and download it locally or send to customers quickly and reliable using our service.
